step_by_step_approach: Identify legislators who are male and represent Louisiana.
Find the start date of each identified legislator's first term.
For each calendar year, compute how many full years have passed from the start of the first term to December 31 of that year.
Keep only those years where the elapsed time is greater than 30 years and less than 50 years.
Verify that each legislator was still in office on December 31 of those years.
Count the distinct legislators that satisfy the above conditions for each specific elapsed year value.
Organize the counts by the exact number of years elapsed since the first term.
